scripts.fmt: pnpm --filter @devhub/desktop fmt:check && pnpm --filter @devhub/bridge fmt:check && pnpm --filter devhub-remote fmt:check
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @devhub/desktop lint && pnpm --filter @devhub/bridge lint && pnpm --filter devhub-remote lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @devhub/desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @devhub/bridge typecheck && pnpm --filter devhub-remote typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @devhub/desktop test && pnpm --filter @devhub/bridge test && pnpm --filter devhub-remote test && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @devhub/desktop build && pnpm --filter @devhub/bridge build && pnpm --filter devhub-remote build
scripts.check: pnpm run bridge:check && pnpm run remote:check && pnpm run fmt && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
